notes_for_editor: Build year, design and registration come from the Register alone; the Register's description contains a typo ('inn 1948') that is quoted as printed. Not used: a Peach Living magazine article in search results says the tower was erected in 1948 and stands 110 feet to the cab, which conflicts with the Register's 100-foot figure. It returned HTTP 403 to our reader, so it is not cited and its wording is not quoted; an editor with access could settle the height. Topo listings give the elevation as 810 ft against the Register's 762 ft (232 m); the story does not state an elevation. Kaufmann is both the Register nominator and the author of the 1819 News essay, which the story discloses. No staffing history or current condition was found, so the status is 'unknown' rather than the brief's 'standing'.
